page.content:
Andrew Lloyd Webber musical that ran at the Majestic longer than any other Broadway show.

How The Phantom of the Opera connects

  • Location: Majestic Theatre — The Phantom of the Opera ran at the Majestic Theatre.
  • Topic: Broadway — The Phantom of the Opera is Broadway's longest original-run monument.
  • Work: Cats — The Phantom of the Opera later passed Cats as Broadway's longest-running show.

What is The Phantom of the Opera?

The Phantom of the Opera is the chandelier musical that opened at the Majestic in 1988 and became Broadway's longest-running show, the late-century monument the district still points to.

Key threads lead to Majestic Theatre, Broadway and Cats.
